author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: an outlined minus bar in the upper-left and an outlined plus (cross outline) in the lower-right, separated by a diagonal slash; distinct from the stroked exposure-compensation variant. A first layout put the slash 4.2 from the minus; the solved layout keeps it 8.5 from the minus and 11 from the plus notch. The rejected drawing kept the frame, which left the outlined symbols no room (plus rendered as a blob).
omissions: The rounded-square frame is dropped and the slash stops short of the corners: inside the frame an outlined plus cannot sit 8 from both the frame and a corner-to-corner slash. The minus bar is 12x8 and the plus spans 16 (smaller than the reference's).
drawing_plan: Minus outline (6,6)-(18,14); plus cross outline centred (34,34), arm half-width 4, half-span 8; slash (8,36)-(36,8).
